Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts; contract rejects ETH.
onlyOwner function that performs an external transfer call on an arbitrary token address.
External caller-controlled address (msg.sender) used for balances, allowances, ownership checks and outbound call arguments.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited balance key inside transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key when approve writes the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender sets its own allowance and is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against the stored owner in the onlyOwner check.
onlyOwner gate controls execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gate controls execution of the arbitrary external token transfer.
acceptOwnership authorizes msg.sender against newOwner before transferring ownership.
safeAdd performs the addition a + b (overflow-guarded arithmetic).
safeSub performs the subtraction a - b (underflow-guarded arithmetic).
safeMul performs the multiplication a * b (overflow-guarded arithmetic).
safeDiv performs the division a / b (zero-guarded arithmetic).
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without a checked math helper.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer writes updated balances into the balances mapping.
approve writes the spender allowance into allowed.
transferFrom calls safeSub to debit the source balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the destination balance.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom updates both from and to entries of the balances mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-controlled spender contract, allowing re-entrant callbacks.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary, caller-supplied token contract.
